api.admission: Caller must reject report.technical_gate_passed=false; helper retains all2F tip errors/alphas instead of discarding failing colors.
api.atlas_material: WhitebaseColorFactor/novertexcolor; MASKcutoff.18; Linear/trilinear withCLAMP_TO_EDGE; do not reuse source normal maps.
api.call: build_color_atlas(fins, material_ids, textures, silhouette, *, cell_width=64, cell_height=32, padding=2, batch_fins=128, pack_by_color=True)
api.geometry: All source arrays are untouched; only cell order/assigned UVs change.
return: uv glTF-V-down float32 in source-fin geometry order
api.source_materials: 1..32 uint8RGB(A) images +linearRGBfactor; distinct-array pixel sum<=16777216. Caller must establish OPAQUE/directUV0/Linear/REPEAT.
api.source_uv: Raw finite abs<=1e6; interpolate first, REPEAT per sample; never modulo endpoints.

limits: Sampling/filtermodels do not establish actualGPUmips,lighting,coverage or densefur quality.
